text:
Alex Rivera: Heads-up — Zenith asked what exact data we need to feed our marketplace cost model for reserve + spot pricing. Want a short, vendor-friendly ask + a tiny CSV they can copy/paste. Can we finalize before lunch?
Maya Lin: Minimal required fields: sku_id, region, date, total_hours, reserved_hours, spot_hours, avg_spot_price_usd, eviction_events_count. Optional but helpful: avg_utilization_pct, burst_allowed(boolean).
Omar Haddad: Add a second CSV for commitment terms: sku_id, commit_tenor_months, reserved_hourly_usd, min_commit_hours, volume_tier_1_threshold, volume_tier_1_discount_pct, credit_latency_days. This maps straight into our pricing engine.
Cassie Park (Finance): Also ask for billing granularity (hour vs minute), whether listed prices are tax inclusive, and whether fees are refundable on eviction (yes/no + policy text). Finance needs that to estimate realized yield.
Alex Rivera: I'll draft the email. Can someone paste a two-row sample CSV? Vendors like examples.
Vendor Integration Bot: Attaching sample CSV snippet:
````
sku_id,region,date,total_hours,reserved_hours,spot_hours,eviction_events_count,avg_spot_price_usd,avg_utilization_pct,burst_allowed
zenith-a100-80gb,us-east-1,2026-03-05,24,480,3200,1,0.68,0.72,true
zenith-a100-80gb,us-east-1,2026-03-06,24,480,3180,0,0.66,0.69,true
````
Omar Haddad: And commit table:
````
sku_id,commit_tenor_months,reserved_hourly_usd,min_commit_hours,volume_tier_1_threshold,volume_tier_1_discount_pct,credit_latency_days
zenith-a100-80gb,12,2.30,1000,10000,5,14
````
Priya (Sales): Also ask vendors to include any "burst_rate_multiplier" if burst pricing is more than base reserved price (e.g., 1.5x). Sales will use that for quoting.
Cassie Park (Finance): Reminder: we asked for a 14-day sample window so our daily-timeseries smoothing works. Add deadline: EOD Wednesday.
Maya Lin: Small ask for eviction event schema: prefer rows with eviction_timestamp_iso, duration_minutes, reason_code. Example line ok.
Vendor Integration Bot: Example eviction detail (one-line JSON allowed in csv field): "{\"eviction_timestamp\":\"2026-03-05T14:12:00Z\",\"duration_min\":8,\"reason\":\"preemptible\"}"
Eng Cost Modeling Bot: Note: our ingestion expects UTC dates and hourly buckets. If they send local timezone, we will convert but flag mismatches.
Alex Rivera: Draft email below. Please edit then I'll send from partnerships@redwood.
Alex Rivera: "Hi Zenith ops team — quick onboarding request to plug your SKUs into Redwood's marketplace cost model. Could you please provide: 1) a 14-day sample of per-region daily availability in CSV (fields: sku_id, region, date (UTC), total_hours, reserved_hours, spot_hours, eviction_events_count, avg_spot_price_usd, avg_utilization_pct, burst_allowed), 2) a commitment-terms CSV (sku_id, commit_tenor_months, reserved_hourly_usd, min_commit_hours, volume_tier thresholds + discounts, credit_latency_days, burst_rate_multiplier if any), and 3) eviction event examples (eviction_timestamp_iso, duration_minutes, reason_code). Please clarify billing granularity (hour/minute), tax treatment, and refund/credit policy for evictions. Attached are two sample rows and a minimal schema you can copy. If easier, we're happy to take a short call to walk through. Could we get this by EOD Wednesday? Thanks — Alex on Partnerships"
Maya Lin: Looks good. Add "preferred file format: CSV, UTF-8".
Priya (Sales): I'll offer a 30-min follow-up call and include Calendly link.
Cassie Park (Finance): Once they send, tagging finance to map to P&L. Cassie will create mapping doc for reserved vs spot revenue recognition.
Omar Haddad: Action items:
- Maya: add csv header schema to the email and attach sample files
- Omar: add eviction schema example to attachments
- Cassie: prepare finance mapping doc and sample journal entries
- Priya: offer sales call in the email
Target send: today by 11:45am PT. :thumbsup:
Vendor Integration Bot: File received: zenith-mini-sample.csv (2 rows)
Alex Rivera: Thanks team — sending in 20m.
